Definition: as if neuter plural of G5036 (adverbially); shortly, i.e. (figuratively) possibly:--peradventure(-haps).
BiblicalUsage: Paul says scarcely for a righteous man will one die, yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die. To Philemon he writes that Onesimus departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever. The word is perhaps, possibly: a small word that leaves room for God's purpose in what looks like loss.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's perhaps in Philemon is the whole letter in one word: what looked like a runaway slave may have been God's road home.
